name: instanode CI — e2e-prod suite failing (P1)
description: P1 (user-visible, recoverable) on ANY InstantCITestRun{suite='e2e-prod', result='fail'} — the live-prod Playwright suite (instanode-web/.github/workflows/e2e-prod.yml) drives full user journeys against PROD on a 30m schedule + post-deploy, so a fail means a user-facing journey is broken IN PRODUCTION right now (the same class the pr-smoke gate would catch pre-merge, but e2e-prod is the continuous prod signal). FACET nothing — any fail pages. Triage: the e2e-prod GitHub run uploads a Playwright trace/screenshot/video artifact; the InstantCITestFailure event for the same commit_sha carries failed_step + log_url; cross-correlate against /healthz .commit_id (rule 14) to name the deploy. The suite only emits when its mint token is configured (RUN=1), so absence of data means it is not yet enabled, not green. Source: instanode-web/.github/workflows/e2e-prod.yml + .github/actions/nr-ci-event.

nrql.query: SELECT count(*) FROM InstantCITestRun WHERE suite = 'e2e-prod' AND result = 'fail'
